title: Time-Corrupted Insanity Crawler
summary: The seasonal crawler combines silence, piercing vulnerability and death-triggered worms.
overview: The seasonal crawler combines silence, piercing vulnerability and death-triggered worms.

sections.title: Encounter strategy
bullets: Control mind worms immediately when a player or pet death brings them into the fight.
Prepare for silence at 50% health and recurring screeches throughout combat.
At 20% health the crawler becomes more vulnerable to piercing attacks.
An out-of-combat reset clears the worms and restores the damage modifiers.

notes: Reviewed quest source; behavior, balance, spawns and completion have not been verified in a live instance.
This document applies to instance version 200.
The tremor timer produces flavor text; no separate tremor damage mechanic is documented.
